productTitle: Unisex Low Top Lace Up Hiking Shoes for Casual Outdoor Walking
productKeywords: unisex lace up hiking shoes casual outdoor walking shoes low top panelled upper
textDesc: Low-cut lace-up outdoor shoes with panelled uppers and a visible textured outsole. Three supplier colors: Black, Tan and Beige. Supplier size labels 36-48; size chart and fit require confirmation before ordering. Wholesale enquiries can include color and size mix, quantity, packaging and destination. This is an externally sourced supplier style; availability, material composition, quotation and dispatch timing are confirmed for each order. Customization feasibility is reviewed on request and is not confirmed for this style.
companyDesc: Quanzhou Beiqiang Footwear & Apparel Co., Ltd. is based in Quanzhou, Fujian, China and serves overseas B2B footwear buyers. Company images describe Beiqiang company-level development, production, checking and order coordination activities; they are not evidence that this externally sourced style is manufactured by Beiqiang. For this style we coordinate supplier availability, specifications and quotation after receiving your requirements.
companyFaqDesc: Which colors and sizes can I enquire about?
The supplier lists Black, Tan and Beige, with size labels 36-48. Please confirm current availability and the size chart for your requested mix; no EU/US conversion is assumed.
What information is needed for a quotation?

Please send the color and size mix, pair quantity, packaging needs and destination. Listed prices are product references; freight, applicable taxes and additional order services are confirmed separately.
Is this style manufactured by Beiqiang?

This is an externally sourced supplier style. Beiqiang coordinates the wholesale enquiry and order requirements. Company production images show general company activities, not production of this specific style.
Can you provide a sample or custom branding?
Tell us the requested color, size, logo artwork and packaging brief. We will check sample availability, customization feasibility, costs and timing for this style before confirming.
When will the order be dispatched?
Dispatch depends on supplier availability, order quantity, size mix and packing requirements. We confirm timing for each order before proceeding.
